S.TRANSL: Sapulungan was up in heaven.

S.FORM: qau vaik a kina kama sema vavua.
S.PHON: qau vaik a kina kama səma vavua
S.FORM: qau vaik a kina kama sema vavua.
S.PHON: qau vaik a kina kama səma vavua
S.TRANSL: His mother and father went to the fields.
He was at home.

S.FORM: qau malap tua tjukutjuku, sa tjukutjukutjuku katua salasaladj.
S.PHON: qau maɭap tua cukucuku sa cukucukucuku katua saɭasaɭaɉ
S.FORM: qau malap tua tjukutjuku, sa tjukutjukutjuku katua salasaladj.
S.PHON: qau maɭap tua cukucuku sa cukucukucuku katua saɭasaɭaɉ
S.TRANSL: He took his ball (or wheel), and played with it with his companions.
Well it got lost.

S.FORM: "qai ɫa qalian, aki pasainu a ku tjukutjuku a maulaw?"
S.PHON: qai ʎa qaɭian aki pasainu a ku cukucuku a mauɭaw
S.FORM: "qai lja qalian, aki pasainu a ku tjukutjuku a maulaw?"
S.PHON: qai ʎa qaɭian aki pasainu a ku cukucuku a mauɭaw
S.TRANSL: "Hi, friends, where has my ball gone that I've lost?"

TRANSL.notes: [kemim: was kemiim with vowel lengthened for emphasis]

S.TRANSL: He looked and looked for it.

S.FORM: manu makelu a maka zua itua buabuang a sema teku.
S.PHON: manu makəɭu a maka zua itua buabuaŋ a səma təku
S.FORM: manu makelu a maka zua itua buabuang a sema teku.
S.PHON: manu makəɭu a maka zua itua buabuaŋ a səma təku
S.TRANSL: Well it had fallen down below through a little hole.

S.FORM: vaik timadju a kitjaviliɫ maka zua pinakazuan nua tjukutjuku nimadju a sema tjariteku.
S.PHON: vaik timaɉu a kicaviɭiʎ maka zua pinakazuan nua cukucuku nimaɉu a səma caritəku
S.FORM: vaik timadju a kitjavililj maka zua pinakazuan nua tjukutjuku nimadju a sema tjariteku.
S.PHON: vaik timaɉu a kicaviɭiʎ maka zua pinakazuan nua cukucuku nimaɉu a səma caritəku
S.TRANSL: He followed the ball by the way it had gone to the world below.

S.FORM: qau kivadaq timadju tua taqaɫaqaɫan: "pasainu a ku tjukutjuku?
S.PHON: qau kivadaq timaɉu tua taqaʎaqaʎan pasainu a ku cukucuku
S.FORM: qau kivadaq timadju tua taqaljaqaljan: "pasainu a ku tjukutjuku?
S.PHON: qau kivadaq timaɉu tua taqaʎaqaʎan pasainu a ku cukucuku
S.TRANSL: He asked the people: "Where has my ball gone?

S.FORM: inika mun a patsun a mapuɫat?"
S.PHON: inika mun a paʦun a mapuʎat
S.FORM: inika mun a pacun a mapuljat?"
S.PHON: inika mun a paʦun a mapuʎat
S.TRANSL: Haven't any of you seen it?"
"We don't know.

S.FORM: pai sa-u kivadaqu ti vuvu i Ḍaḍengeraw."
S.PHON: pai sau kivadaqu ti vuvu i ɖaɖəŋəraw
S.FORM: pai sa-u kivadaqu ti vuvu i Dradrengeraw."
S.PHON: pai sau kivadaqu ti vuvu i ɖaɖəŋəraw
S.TRANSL: Go and ask granny Ḍaḍengeraw."
He went to ask her.

S.PHON: inika kən a kəmʎaŋ aja timaɉu
inika kən a kəmʎaŋ aja timaɉu
S.TRANSL: She said: "I don't know."

S.FORM: manu patsunan ni Sapulungan izua i tjaiteku i surur.
S.PHON: manu paʦunan ni sapuɭuŋan izua i caitəku i surur
S.FORM: manu pacunan ni Sapulungan izua i tjaiteku i surur.
S.PHON: manu paʦunan ni sapuɭuŋan izua i caitəku i surur
S.TRANSL: Then Sapulungan saw it there under the bed-platform.
Sapulungan picked it up.

S.PHON: uza imaza vuvu sa ku cukucuku
uza imaza vuvu sa ku cukucuku
S.TRANSL: "Here's my ball, granny."

S.FORM: "ini anga ka ken a tsemged a patsun."
S.PHON: ini aŋa ka kən a ʦəmgəd a paʦun
S.FORM: "ini anga ka ken a cemged a pacun."
S.PHON: ini aŋa ka kən a ʦəmgəd a paʦun
S.TRANSL: "I can't see clearly any more."

S.PHON: uri imazaŋa kən i canusun vuvu
uri imazaŋa kən i canusun vuvu
S.TRANSL: "I'm going to stay with you, granny."
"Others are going fishing, granny.
What am I to take?"
"Take this pot-holder to fish with."
Well the others didn't catch anything;
but he used a pole to carry the fish he caught.

S.PHON: uri vuvu uri qəmaʎup a qaɭiqaɭi
uri vuvu uri qəmaʎup a qaɭiqaɭi
S.TRANSL: "Granny, others are going hunting.
What am I to take?"

S.FORM: "katsuu aitsu a ku velayan a qemaɫup."
S.PHON: kaʦuu aiʦu a ku vəɭajan a qəmaʎup
S.FORM: "kacuu aicu a ku velayan a qemaljup."
S.PHON: kaʦuu aiʦu a ku vəɭajan a qəmaʎup
S.TRANSL: "Take this net-needle to hunt with."
Off he went.

S.PHON: manu maja kitəvətəvəʎ ti ca qaɭi
manu maja kitəvətəvəʎ ti ca qaɭi
S.TRANSL: But the others said: "Don't go near this chap.
It's taboo to carry a net-needle when we're hunting."
They went hunting;

S.FORM: manu malap ti Sapulungan a semuliaw.
S.PHON: manu maɭap ti sapuɭuŋan a səmuɭiaw
S.FORM: manu malap ti Sapulungan a semuliaw.
S.PHON: manu maɭap ti sapuɭuŋan a səmuɭiaw
S.TRANSL: and Sapulungan caught lots,
but the others didn't catch anything.
"Granny, others are going head-hunting.
What am I to take?"
"Take my net-needle."
"Don't come near us.

S.FORM: namasi velayan sun," ayain nua qaliqali.
S.PHON: namasi vəɭajan sun ajain nua qaɭiqaɭi
S.FORM: namasi velayan sun," ayain nua qaliqali.
S.PHON: namasi vəɭajan sun ajain nua qaɭiqaɭi
S.TRANSL: You're carrying a net-needle," said the others.
But he killed a lot,
while the others didn't kill anybody.
They were all angry.
"What are we going to do with this chap?
Why haven't we been able to do anything?
Let's kill him."

S.FORM: qau kivala ti Sapulungan; kilangda tua mazepzepzep.
S.PHON: qau kivaɭa ti sapuɭuŋan kiɭaŋda tua mazəpzəpzəp
S.FORM: qau kivala ti Sapulungan; kilangda tua mazepzepzep.
S.PHON: qau kivaɭa ti sapuɭuŋan kiɭaŋda tua mazəpzəpzəp
S.TRANSL: Sapulungan was out for a stroll, and heard them discussing.

TRANSL.notes: [ru: not in F24 or F248 for future]

S.TRANSL: So he was going to be killed.
He went indoors

S.FORM: pasemalaw tua vuvu: "uzau ru qetsin aken nua taqaɫaqaɫan.
S.PHON: pasəmaɭaw tua vuvu uzau ru qəʦin akən nua taqaʎaqaʎan
S.FORM: pasemalaw tua vuvu: "uzau ru qecin aken nua taqaljaqaljan.
S.PHON: pasəmaɭaw tua vuvu uzau ru qəʦin akən nua taqaʎaqaʎan
S.TRANSL: and told the granny: "The people are planning to kill me.

S.FORM: uri vaik aken, vuvu, a sema tjarivavaw."
S.PHON: uri vaik akən vuvu a səma carivavaw
S.FORM: uri vaik aken, vuvu, a sema tjarivavaw."
S.PHON: uri vaik akən vuvu a səma carivavaw
S.TRANSL: I'm going off to heaven, granny."
"No, Sapulungan, stay on here.
What does it matter what others say?"

S.FORM: "ini, vuvu, uri vaik aken a sema tjarivavaw."
S.PHON: ini vuvu uri vaik akən a səma carivavaw
S.FORM: "ini, vuvu, uri vaik aken a sema tjarivavaw."
S.PHON: ini vuvu uri vaik akən a səma carivavaw
S.TRANSL: "No, granny, I'm going to heaven."
He planted a small whetstone in the ground.
It grew big enough to reach up to heaven.
He took his ball.

S.FORM: "aitsu, vuvu, nu metad sa ku inapuan, sataladju anga tua surur."
S.PHON: aiʦu vuvu nu mətad sa ku inapuan sataɭaɉu aŋa tua surur
S.FORM: "aicu, vuvu, nu metad sa ku inapuan, sataladju anga tua surur."
S.PHON: aiʦu vuvu nu mətad sa ku inapuan sataɭaɉu aŋa tua surur
S.TRANSL: "Now, granny, when my betel-nut quid has dried, put it under the bed-platform."

S.FORM: vaik ti Sapulungan a sema vavaw, a tsemikel a sema tjarivavaw.
S.PHON: vaik ti sapuɭuŋan a səma vavaw a ʦəmikəɭ a səma carivavaw
S.FORM: vaik ti Sapulungan a sema vavaw, a cemikel a sema tjarivavaw.
S.PHON: vaik ti sapuɭuŋan a səma vavaw a ʦəmikəɭ a səma carivavaw
S.TRANSL: Sapulungan went up and returned to heaven.

S.FORM: ka zemuker i tjarivavaw, djakadjaken nimadju a ventseluq.
S.PHON: ka zəmukər i carivavaw ɉakaɉakən nimaɉu a vənʦəɭuq
S.FORM: ka zemuker i tjarivavaw, djakadjaken nimadju a venceluq.
S.PHON: ka zəmukər i carivavaw ɉakaɉakən nimaɉu a vənʦəɭuq
S.TRANSL: When he reached heaven, he kicked and broke the whetstone pillar (implied);

S.FORM: manu matsay anga mapuɫat a taqaɫaqaɫan i Valivaliw.
S.PHON: manu maʦaj aŋa mapuʎat a taqaʎaqaʎan i vaɭivaɭiw
S.FORM: manu macay anga mapuljat a taqaljaqaljan i Valivaliw.
S.PHON: manu maʦaj aŋa mapuʎat a taqaʎaqaʎan i vaɭivaɭiw
S.TRANSL: and all the people of Valivaliw were killed.

S.FORM: amin anga ti Ḍaḍengeraw nu vaɫut.
S.PHON: amin aŋa ti ɖaɖəŋəraw nu vaʎut
S.FORM: amin anga ti Dradrengeraw nu valjut.
S.PHON: amin aŋa ti ɖaɖəŋəraw nu vaʎut
S.TRANSL: Only Ḍaḍengeraw survived.

S.FORM: ka i tjarivavaw anga ti Sapulungan, manu "pasainu sun?
S.PHON: ka i carivavaw aŋa ti sapuɭuŋan manu pasainu sun
S.FORM: ka i tjarivavaw anga ti Sapulungan, manu "pasainu sun?
S.PHON: ka i carivavaw aŋa ti sapuɭuŋan manu pasainu sun
S.TRANSL: When Sapulungan got to heaven, his parents asked: "Where have you been?
We thought you must be dead.
But here you are."
"I followed (my ball) to the world below.

S.FORM: qau izuanga ken i tjai vuvu i Ḍaḍengeraw.
S.PHON: qau izuaŋa kən i cai vuvu i ɖaɖəŋəraw
S.FORM: qau izuanga ken i tjai vuvu i Dradrengeraw.
S.PHON: qau izuaŋa kən i cai vuvu i ɖaɖəŋəraw
S.TRANSL: And I stayed there with granny Ḍaḍengeraw.

S.FORM: qau uri qetsin aken; mana ku sivaik a sema maza i tjarivavaw," aya timadju a pasemalaw tua matjaɫaɫak.
S.PHON: qau uri qəʦin akən mana ku sivaik a səma maza i carivavaw aja timaɉu a pasəmaɭaw tua macaʎaʎak
S.FORM: qau uri qecin aken; mana ku sivaik a sema maza i tjarivavaw," aya timadju a pasemalaw tua matjaljaljak.
S.PHON: qau uri qəʦin akən mana ku sivaik a səma maza i carivavaw aja timaɉu a pasəmaɭaw tua macaʎaʎak
S.TRANSL: But I was going to be killed; that's why I left and came back here to heaven," he told his parents.

S.FORM: qemaung anga a kina kama, saka "kana matsay sun, kana inika men a kemɫang," aya tiamadju.
S.PHON: qəmauŋ aŋa a kina kama saka kana maʦaj sun kana inika mən a kəmʎaŋ aja tiamaɉu
S.FORM: qemaung anga a kina kama, saka "kana macay sun, kana inika men a kemljang," aya tiamadju.
S.PHON: qəmauŋ aŋa a kina kama saka kana maʦaj sun kana inika mən a kəmʎaŋ aja tiamaɉu
S.TRANSL: His mother and father cried. They said; "If you had died, we wouldn't have known."

S.FORM: azua i Valivaliw a mui mana nataɫiw ni Sapulungan.
S.PHON: azua i vaɭivaɭiw a mui mana nataʎiw ni sapuɭuŋan
S.FORM: azua i Valivaliw a mui mana nataljiw ni Sapulungan.
S.PHON: azua i vaɭivaɭiw a mui mana nataʎiw ni sapuɭuŋan
S.TRANSL: The white stone at Valivaliw is from Sapulungan's whetstone.
The end.
